_comment: Firm-owned configuration. Fill these before launch. Empty values hide the related element and print a build warning. Never commit secrets here; everything in this file is public in the built site.
name: Metanoia Advisory

forms._comment: provider: netlify (default on Netlify hosting, no keys needed), web3forms (paste the access key from web3forms.com, or set WEB3FORMS_KEY in the host's environment variables), formspree (paste the form IDs from formspree.io), hubspot (uses the hubspot block above) or none. On Cloudflare Pages, 'netlify' switches to web3forms by itself, because Netlify Forms only works on Netlify.

analytics._comment: Optional cookieless analytics: the site domain registered at plausible.io (or leave empty).

offers._comment: Published prices. Leave a price empty and the page says the fee is fixed and confirmed before work starts. Example: { "en": "Rp 15 million, excluding VAT", "id": "Rp 15 juta, belum termasuk PPN" }.

tools._comment: deckCheck: the free in-browser deck check. 'preview' builds the page at its address but keeps it out of search engines, the sitemap and the site's own links, so it can be tried on real decks first. 'live' links it from the Deck Audit page and the footer. 'off' does not build it.

ai._comment: Set deckDiagnostic to true after adding ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to the host's environment variables; the function lives in netlify/functions/deck-diagnostic.mjs.
